title: Dhaba Style Chicken Karahi
steps: Heat oil in a wok (karahi). Add chicken and fry on high heat until the color changes.
Add ginger garlic paste and fry for another 2 minutes.
Place halved tomatoes face down over the chicken, cover, and steam on low heat for 10 mins.
Remove the tomato skins, increase heat, and mash the tomatoes into the chicken to form a thick gravy.
Add salt, crushed black pepper, and cumin. Fry vigorously (bhunai) until oil separates.
Garnish with julienned ginger and green chilies. Serve with fresh naan.
